concerns.text: Task T008 substitutes the required MoE student (FR-002, US-1) with a dense 1.8B Qwen model. The spec explicitly demands a 'Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) student' to test architectural inductive bias. Replacing MoE with a dense model silently weakens the core hypothesis test, violating FR-002 and US-1 acceptance criteria.

Tasks T024-T035 hardcode exactly 3 seeds (42, 43, 44) for training runs. FR-006 and SC-002 require 'cluster-robust standard errors' and a 'paired t-test/Wilcoxon' on performance gain distributions. A sample size of n=3 is statistically insufficient to calculate cluster-robust errors or perform valid significance testing, rendering the statistical analysis tasks (T039-T045) untestable and the acceptance criteria for US-3 impossible to satisfy.

Tasks T005.1 and T014.5 fetch 'human-verified' labels from the same dataset ID (`HuggingFaceH4/aime_2024`) used for training. SC-006 and FR-009 mandate validation against 'human-verified correctness labels' on a *held-out* set to ensure the metric is not tautological. If the dataset lacks a distinct 'human_verified' field separate from the 'solution' used for training, this task fails to satisfy the non-tautological constraint required by the spec.

Tasks T022 and T033 rely on T011.5/T011.6 for memory enforcement but lack a specific task to implement the *integration logic* connecting the monitor's OOM signal to the trainer's parameter update loop. FR-007 requires 'automatically reducing batch sizes' during execution. Without a task explicitly defining this integration, the 'automatic reduction' constraint is not preserved in the implementation plan.
